resources.string: Connect directly to your own Immich server. Enter its URL and API key using your TV remote or keyboard. No pairing service is used. Re-enter the API key when changing these settings.
Use a complete HTTP or HTTPS server URL without credentials, spaces, query parameters, or a fragment.
HTTP exposes your API key, photos, and videos to anyone who can intercept the connection. Use it only on a trusted private LAN. HTTPS is recommended. Continue with HTTP?
